tools.name: address_translate
tools.description: Translate or transliterate a street address into another language using WIA Address (OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocoding; for Korean addresses also the Korean government road-name address API). Returns structured fields, not an official postal confirmation. The address text is sent to third-party geoc

tools.name: address_korea_lookup
tools.description: Normalize a Korean address using the Korean government road-name address data: returns road-name address, lot-number (jibun) address, postal code, building name and the official English road-name address. Does not return coordinates. The keyword is sent to the government address service via WIA Addr
